instruction: A skateboard rendered as a glowing neon wireframe, its deck, trucks, and four wheels drawn only in luminous electric-magenta and cyan edges against darkness. The grid lines pulse with emissive bloom, tracing the concave curve of the deck like a floating hologram outline.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Neon Skateboard in a neon-wireframe style. A skateboard rendered as a glowing neon wireframe, its deck, trucks, and four wheels drawn only in luminous electric-magenta and cyan edges against darkness. The grid lines pulse with emissive bloom, tracing the concave curve of the deck like a floating hologram outline. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
